review_limitations: This is a read-only content review and scope reconciliation, not cryptographic identity verification, legal advice, or a replacement for an operator/contract-owner approval record.
The seven nested ZIPs are historical snapshots with overlapping content; their 20,436 entry count is not a count of unique files.
The scan covered 19,504 decodable text members in the seven snapshots plus all 50 high-priority source members. Non-text binaries were integrity checked but not semantically interpreted.

The Phase S statement that authority evidence was absent was expressly limited to its pinned Phase P/Q/R record set; this review does not make a global absence claim about records outside the reviewed bundle/snapshots or uncaptured conversations.

Historical payload materialization flags and runtime PASS labels were reviewed in their artifact scope; in-memory or isolated test payloads are not equivalent to current production payload/media authorization.

key_findings.finding: The current Phase R operator policy packet is preparation-only. R-01 through R-07 remain UNDECIDED_NO_POLICY_AUTHORIZED; R-08 and R-09 are BLOCKED_EXPLICIT_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED. No broad R decision is adopted by this review.

The current Phase S preflight found no qualifying authority record in the specified pinned P/Q/R record set only; its global_absence_claim is false. It requires explicit decision IDs/options, authority identity and scope, effective date, rationale, source pins, acceptance obligations, approval provenance, and immutable record location.

Three historical, explicitly limited decision records exist: semantic definitions for CHALLENGE_003/005/006/007 for future binding specification; field-region/visibility acceptance for future coordinate policy specification; and coordinate choices for future consumer specification. They do not approve runtime transforms, bindings, renderer projection, render tests, payload/media creation, release or promotion. The coordinate record cites a generic standing engineering approval, which the Phase S contract says is insufficient to authorize product policy.

Historical isolated runtime/static acceptance evidence exists (including an allowlisted source-composition harness and a V2C source-frame route), but the records state their limited scope and do not authorize production wiring, renderer activation, current payload/media, bindings, seed-sensitivity certification or promotion.

Historical `D9.15` GUI acceptance labels and older milestone snapshots are dated and narrower than the latest current state. They do not supersede current D9.17 BLOCKED/NO-GO, D10 BLOCKED_FOR_PROMOTION, D4.8 BLOCKED, baseline approval missing, and release authority NONE.

No qualifying source authorizes a broad current renderer or release gate. CHALLENGE_008.active_selection and CHALLENGE_009.displayed_count stay blocked because total_duration=11s conflicts with the 12s phase sum; no fix is inferred.
